data.description:
## Context / Problem
Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

`gen_env_registry.render()` (`scripts/gen_env_registry.py:489-497`) unions derived names only for `REBAR_MCP_*` (via `MCP_ENV_VARS`), so 64 settable `REBAR_<SECTION>_<KEY>` names (verified against `tests/golden/config_surface.json`: 104 canonical, 40 already scanned, 64 missing — 27 `VERIFY`, 10 `RECONCILER`, 4 `CODE_HEALTH`, …) are absent from `docs/env-vars.md` (165 rows today). The canary keeps a "one-release" rollback source (`scripts/canary_bridge.py:156-164,709-715`; `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml:52-59,79,171`) two releases after ADR 0094. `CHANGELOG.md:330-343` files commit `334ee94` (2026-09-03, ticket `828b-fe4a-b05a-48fb`, NOT an ancestor of `v0.13.0`/`v0.13.1`) under `[0.13.0]`; commit `81da792` (ticket `fdd1-12fa-ce83-45d1`, retired `REBAR_HLC=0`) has no CHANGELOG entry.

## Approach
- **Registry (decision: derive all).** In `render()` replace `:489-497` with: `from rebar._config_schema import _SECTIONS; from rebar._config_sources import _canonical_env_name; for sect, keys in _SECTIONS.items(): for key in keys: reads.setdefault(_canonical_env_name(sect, key), set()).add(f"src/rebar/_config_sections.py (canonical env name of {sect}.{key})")`; keep the `MCP_ENV_VARS` union for `REBAR_MCP_DEDUP` (in `MCP_ENV_VARS`, not a config key). Regenerate `docs/env-vars.md` (+64 rows → 227 after the test-hooks story). Do **not** change `scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_config.py:63-81` (adding 64 `env_var::` entries would trip `check_mechanism_delta --check` with `new=64` and no marker path); update its docstring `:8-15` and `docs/architecture.md:629` to state the deliberate asymmetry: the ratchet censuses definition sites, and a derived name's site is its `_SECTIONS` row, already counted as `config_key`/`feature_flag`. Tests: `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py` add `test_every_canonical_env_name_is_documented` (all 104 `_canonical_env_name` results appear as ``| `NAME` |`` rows in `render()`); `:43-56` unchanged (`REBAR_PUSH` still absent). `tests/unit/test_env_registry_helper_coverage.py` needs no edit (it covers `_llm_*` helpers only).
- **Canary.** `scripts/canary_bridge.py`: delete `:156-161` and `:709-715`, `cmd_check_heartbeat` calls `_check_status_heartbeat` directly; keep `_check_github_heartbeat` for the `NEVER_RUN` bootstrap (`:203-212`, ADR 0094 `:81-82` forbids dropping it), make `bootstrap` a required keyword (no default) and drop the `if bootstrap` conditional at `:345`. Workflow `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml`: delete `:52-59` (the `status_source` dispatch input) and `:79` (the `REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE` job env); `:171` becomes `python scripts/canary_bridge.py check-heartbeat`; the `:53` description text goes with it. The named `run:` steps censused as `ci_gate::` rows in `.github/mechanism-baseline.json:299-310` stay; `REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE` has no `env_var::` row, so the mechanism ratchet is unaffected. Docs: `docs/jira-sync-setup.md:191` (delete sentence), `:294` (delete row); `docs/adr/0094-reconciler-last-pass-two-witness-status.md` append a dated "Status" paragraph after `:82` recording the rollback source's removal; `docs/release-notes.md:696-698` stays historical. Tests: `tests/scripts/test_canary_bridge.py:95` remove the key and have `hb_env`'s runner answer `rebar bridge status` with `{"verdict":"NEVER_RUN"}` so `:115-190` exercise the run-history math via bootstrap; `tests/scripts/test_canary_bridge_heldout.py:74,145` remove the key, delete `:163-174`; `tests/scripts/test_canary_status_refs_heldout.py:133` remove the key.
- **CHANGELOG.** Move `CHANGELOG.md:330-343` (both bullets are the one commit `334ee94`) into `[Unreleased]` `### Changed` after `:97`. Add under `[Unreleased]`: "- **BREAKING (pre-1.0): the `REBAR_HLC=0` rollback switch is removed.** The Hybrid Logical Clock is always on; the variable is ignored (commit `81da792`, ticket `fdd1-12fa-ce83-45d1`)." Add the alias story's tombstone entry (its release-note text), the `[llm]` unknown-key entry, the test-hooks entry ("test-only `REBAR_HLC_NOW` / `REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER` are no longer read by rebar"), and "`docs/env-vars.md` now lists every `REBAR_<SECTION>_<KEY>` override".

## Scope
`scripts/gen_env_registry.py`, `scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_config.py` (docstring `:8-15` only), `docs/env-vars.md`, `docs/architecture.md:629`, `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py`, `scripts/canary_bridge.py`, `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml`, `docs/jira-sync-setup.md`, `docs/adr/0094-reconciler-last-pass-two-witness-status.md`, `tests/scripts/test_canary_bridge.py`, `tests/scripts/test_canary_bridge_heldout.py`, `tests/scripts/test_canary_status_refs_heldout.py`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`. Out of scope: the `scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_config.py:63-81` detector logic, `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`, `tests/unit/test_env_registry_helper_coverage.py`, the `_check_github_heartbeat` bootstrap path (kept per ADR 0094 `:81-82`), and `docs/release-notes.md:696-698` (historical).

## Testing
- `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` clean after regeneration; `grep -c '^| `REBAR_' docs/env-vars.md` = 227; `grep -n 'REBAR_VERIFY_REQUIRE_PLAN_REVIEW_FOR_CLAIM\|REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS' docs/env-vars.md` both present.
- `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` → `new=0`.
- `pytest tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py tests/scripts/test_canary_bridge*.py tests/scripts/test_canary_status_refs_heldout.py tests/unit/test_canary_bridge_wiring.py tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py -q`.
- Edge: `python scripts/canary_bridge.py check-heartbeat --source github-api` → argparse error (exit 2); `REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE=github-api python scripts/canary_bridge.py check-heartbeat` with a `NEVER_RUN` fake → uses the bootstrap witness, output contains `(last-pass producer bootstrap fallback)`.
- `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC1 `docs/env-vars.md` contains all 104 canonical names (verified by the new `test_every_canonical_env_name_is_documented`) and `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` is clean.
- [ ] AC2 `git grep -n 'REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE\|github-api' -- scripts .github tests` empty (verified by the grep); `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` green.
- [ ] AC3 `CHANGELOG.md` `[0.13.0]` no longer contains the `force="<reason>"` / `openai-chat` bullets; `[Unreleased]` carries them plus the `REBAR_HLC` entry (verified by `grep -n 'force_close\|REBAR_HLC' CHANGELOG.md` line numbers < 99).
- [ ] AC4 `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0`; `make verify` green.
data.title: Derive every canonical env name in the env registry, retire the canary `github-api` source, and file the CHANGELOG bookkeeping
